findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_glp1_providers, get_glp1_provider, get_glp1_signup_link, get_glp1_reviews, search_glp1_reviews · Private data: get_glp1_pharmacy, search_glp1_reviews · Public sink: get_glp1_provider, get_glp1_reviews, compare_glp1_providers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_glp1_providers, get_glp1_provider, get_glp1_signup_link, get_glp1_reviews, search_glp1_reviews · Private data: get_glp1_pharmacy, search_glp1_reviews · Public sink: get_glp1_provider, get_glp1_reviews, compare_glp1_providers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_glp1_providers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
